The science, in numbers

Why salim

We believe skincare should be part of every man's daily routine. Your skin is one of your most defining features, and looking after it is how you look and feel your best.

Too many men go without the right products for their skin. So we made a cream that's locally sourced, made in Australia, and simple enough for any routine.

Whether you're a busy professional or always on the move, our goal is the same: restore a natural glow and build confidence through skincare.

Help and policies

Shipping

We ship within Australia. Orders placed before 2pm (AEST) on a business day usually leave the same day. Standard delivery takes 3 to 7 business days after dispatch. Shipping costs are shown at checkout before you pay.

Delivery times are estimates and can be affected by carriers and public holidays. We'll email you a tracking link once your order leaves us.

Returns and refunds

If your product arrives damaged, faulty or is not as described, contact us within [14] days of delivery. We'll repair, replace or refund it, and we'll cover the return postage.

If you change your mind, you can return an unopened product within [30] days for a refund of the product price, less the return postage. Opened products can't be returned for hygiene reasons.

Refunds are processed to your original payment method within [10] business days of us receiving the return.

Nothing in these terms limits your rights under the Australian Consumer Law. Our products come with guarantees that can't be excluded, including that they are of acceptable quality and fit for purpose.

Frequently asked questions

How do I use the cream?

Cleanse your face, apply a small amount to clean, dry skin, and massage in circular motions until absorbed. Use morning and evening.

Is it suitable for sensitive skin?

The cream is dermatologist tested. If you have sensitive skin or a known allergy, patch test a small area first and check the ingredient list on the box before use.

Is it vegan or cruelty free?

The cream is not tested on animals. Check the ingredient list on the box for every ingredient before you buy if you have specific dietary or ethical requirements.

How long does a tube last?

A 50 ml tube lasts about [X] weeks at twice-daily use. We'll confirm this figure before it goes live.

Do you ship overseas?

Not yet. We ship within Australia only.

Your rights

Liability

Privacy

We respect your privacy and handle your personal information in line with the Australian Privacy Principles.

What we collect

  • Details you give us, such as your name, email, shipping address and phone number when you place an order.
  • Messages and choices you send through our forms.
  • Basic information about how you use the website, such as pages visited, through cookies and analytics.

How we use it

To process and deliver orders, answer your messages, improve our products and site, and, only if you opt in, send you marketing emails. You can unsubscribe from marketing at any time using the link in those emails.

Who we share it with

With service providers who help us run the store, such as payment, delivery and email providers. Some may be located overseas. We don't sell your personal information.

Your choices

You can ask to see, correct or delete the personal information we hold about you by emailing us. If you think we've breached your privacy, contact us first. If you're not satisfied, you can complain to the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner.

Cookies

We use cookies that keep the site working, such as remembering your cart, and optional analytics cookies. You can clear or block cookies in your browser settings.
